expectations.text: Unique identity for each AI agent, distinct from personnel accounts and other agents (ISM-2133)
expectations.evidence: "give the agent a unique identity distinct from any personnel account" (ISM-2133–2135)

expectations.text: An AI agent register — maintained and regularly verified — recording identifier, owner/purpose, identities, credentials, and tools/permissions/data accessible (ISM-2134/2135)
expectations.evidence: "maintain an AI agent register recording identifier, owner/purpose, associated identities/credentials, and the specific tools, permissions, and data the agent can access. Review this register regularly"

expectations.text: Restriction to minimum tools, functions and permissions for the intended purpose (ISM-2156), with tool invocations subject to BOTH the invoking user's access controls AND agent-specific task-scoped authorisation (ISM-2157)
expectations.evidence: "scoped to only the tools and functions its task requires" and "checked against BOTH the invoking user's own access controls AND a separate, task-scoped authorisation issued to the agent itself" (ISM-2156–2159)

expectations.text: External content treated as untrusted throughout processing: delimited from system instructions, validated/sanitised, and prevented from overriding instructions, security policies, access controls or human-approval requirements (ISM-2158)
expectations.evidence: "treated as untrusted data throughout, kept delimited from system/developer instructions, and structurally prevented from overriding security policy or triggering bypass of human-approval gates"

expectations.text: Central logging of all tool invocations, external requests and outputs (ISM-2159), plus human approval before sensitive/high-impact actions (ISM-2113 as amended)
expectations.evidence: "all tool invocations, external requests, and outputs must be logged centrally" plus "carried over from ISM-2113 (June 2026, wording amended in September)... human sign-off before executing sensitive or high-impact actions"
